items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: And it was Charlie Calello was producing Richie Havens.

ctx.x: Jesus I can’t think of his name. Losing my brain. Richie Havens.

Richie Havens yeah. And it was Charlie Calello was producing Richie Havens. And Charlie was a great arranger. He did all the Four Seasons arrangements and stuff like that and you know he’s the one the came up with [scats]. Great arranger. But he was producing Richie Havens. And somebody was playing drums and he was not happy with the drums, he kept changing the drum part and the drummer couldn’t remember like what he wanted. And he’d start the take and we’d get to the part and he wouldn’t play what Charlie…
Yeah. Well no one got hurt except their feelings.
